templates.title: First class
templates.summary: Walk in, see the drop-in price, meet the coach, film your own reps and say how the class felt.

steps.title: Walk in
steps.position: Outside, a few steps from the studio door
steps.direction: Phone at chest height, walk slowly up to the door until it fills the screen.

captions.script: My first class here, and I have no idea what I signed up for.
Trying a class I have never done before, come with me.

steps.title: Drop-in price
steps.position: Inside, at the front desk
steps.direction: Start close on the price board or the class menu, then lean back slowly so the desk comes into view.

captions.script: Here is what one drop-in class costs, right on the board.
Ask about a first class price, and check the board before you pay.

steps.title: Meet the coach
steps.position: Next to the instructor, before class
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, a little above eye level with the instructor beside you, both in frame. Say who is teaching today.
steps.prompter: Meet my coach for today, they promised to go easy on me.

captions.script: Meet my coach for today, they promised to go easy on me.
This is who is teaching today, and I already feel nervous.

steps.title: In the class
steps.position: On your mat or station, phone propped on the floor
steps.direction: Prop the phone low against a bottle so only you are in frame, then do a few reps. Keep other members out of the shot.

captions.script: Halfway through and this is already harder than it looks.
Mid class, trying to keep up with everyone else in the room.

steps.title: Hands on
steps.position: Same spot, phone held above your hands
steps.direction: Hold the phone above your hands on the kit (the bar, the kettlebell handle, the mat) and keep it still for one rep.

captions.script: Here is how the coach set my grip for every rep.
Every rep counts. Here is one of them, up close.

steps.title: After class
steps.position: In the lobby or outside, after class
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, a little above eye level, still in your gear. Say honestly how the class felt.
steps.prompter: Class done, legs shaking, and I am booking the next one.

captions.script: Class done, legs shaking, and I am booking the next one.
Honest verdict: hard, friendly coach, and I would go back.

steps.title: Book it
steps.position: At the class schedule or the desk
steps.direction: Film the class schedule on the wall and move in slowly toward the class you took.

captions.script: Find the schedule and book your first class through Loca.
Class times are on the board, pick one and come try it.

templates.title: Gym tour
templates.summary: The standout kit, the floor, the racks, the changing room and who the gym is for, in under thirty seconds.

steps.title: Standout kit
steps.position: In front of the one machine or room nobody else has
steps.direction: Phone low, pointed up at the standout kit (the rig, the sled track, the cold plunge), move in slowly.

captions.script: I have never seen this in a gym before, so here is the tour.
Quick tour of this gym, starting with the best thing in it.

steps.title: The floor
steps.position: At one end of the main floor, in a quiet hour
steps.direction: Start mid-turn as if you just whipped in, then turn your hips slowly to show the whole floor. Film when it is empty.

captions.script: This is the main floor, and here is how busy it gets.
Here is how much room there is to train.

steps.title: The racks
steps.position: Beside the dumbbell rack or the cardio row
steps.direction: Hold the phone close to the rack and slide sideways along it at an even pace.

captions.script: Here are the weights, from the light ones to the heavy ones.
Full rack and it is all in order, which says a lot.

steps.title: Changing room
steps.position: At the changing room door, when it is empty
steps.direction: Check the room is empty first. Start with the lens behind the door frame, then step in past it.

captions.script: Here are the changing rooms, and what is in them.
Here is what is in there, so you know what to bring.

steps.title: Who it is for
steps.position: Facing the owner or a coach at the front desk
steps.direction: Back camera on the owner at the desk, front camera on you. Say who this gym is for.
steps.prompter: I asked the owner who this place is for. Here is the answer.

captions.script: I asked the owner who this place is for. Here is the answer.
Asked the owner who trains here, and here is what they said.

steps.title: Find it
steps.position: Outside, with the sign behind you
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, a little above eye level with the gym sign over your shoulder. Say where it is.
steps.prompter: That was the whole gym in thirty seconds, find it on Loca.

captions.script: That was the whole gym in thirty seconds, find it on Loca.
The price is on screen, go see the floor for yourself.

templates.title: First sauna session
templates.summary: A first visit to a sauna or cold plunge studio: the door, the room, what to bring, and how it felt.

steps.title: The door
steps.position: Outside the sauna, hand on the door
steps.direction: Phone at eye level, open the door and move in slowly toward the wood and the steam until they fill the screen.

captions.script: First time in a sauna studio, and I had no idea what to bring.
Sauna day, and this is the door I was nervous about.

steps.title: The room
steps.position: Inside the empty sauna room
steps.direction: Before anyone is in, hold the phone high and close to the bench, then lean back slowly to show the whole room.

captions.script: Here are the benches, the stove, and how many people fit.
This is the hot room, and yes, it is as warm as it looks.

steps.title: What to bring
steps.position: In the changing area, at a bench
steps.direction: Phone straight above the bench. Lay out what you brought one item at a time (towel, flip-flops, water bottle).

captions.script: Here is what I brought, one thing at a time.
Pack these and you are ready for your first session.

steps.title: Step in
steps.position: Outside the sauna door, phone propped low
steps.direction: Prop the phone low on a bench outside the door and walk through it. Film only yourself, and only when the room is free.

captions.script: Okay, here we go, into the heat.
Round one. Here is how long I stay in the heat.

steps.title: How it felt
steps.position: In the rest area, after the session
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, a little above eye level in the rest area. Say how the session felt, nothing more.
steps.prompter: Here is how many rounds I did, and I feel so calm.

captions.script: Here is how many rounds I did, and I feel so calm.
First time verdict: hot, quiet, and I would come back again.

steps.title: Session price
steps.position: At the reception, by the price list
steps.direction: Film the price list and move in slowly to the session you had.

captions.script: Here is what one session costs, and what it includes.
Here is the price list, book your first session on Loca.

templates.title: One move from the coach
templates.summary: The coach shows one beginner move, the stance up close, you copy it, and the class it comes from.

steps.title: The move
steps.position: A few metres from the coach, in an empty corner
steps.direction: Phone low and still, film the coach doing the move once at full speed (a swing, a squat, a flow).

captions.script: One move every beginner should learn, straight from the coach.
This is the move the coach picked for beginners.

steps.title: Meet the coach
steps.position: Facing the coach, at eye level
steps.direction: Back camera on the coach's head and shoulders, front camera on you. Say what you are about to learn.
steps.prompter: This is my coach, and they have one move every beginner should learn.

captions.script: This is my coach, and they have one move every beginner should learn.
Lesson one from the coach, and here is why it matters.

steps.title: The setup
steps.position: Standing over the coach's feet or hands
steps.direction: Hold the phone straight down over the coach's feet or grip while they set up. Keep it still.

captions.script: Here is the setup, step by step, before the move.
Watch the setup closely. Here is how the coach does it.

steps.title: My turn
steps.position: On the same spot, phone propped on the floor
steps.direction: Prop the phone low so only you are in frame, then do the move three times.

captions.script: My turn, and it looks a lot easier when the coach does it.
Trying it myself, slower, with the coach watching my feet.

steps.title: How it felt
steps.position: Same spot, after the reps
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, a little above eye level. Say how it felt and what you will remember.
steps.prompter: A few reps of that and I finally get why people love this class.

captions.script: A few reps of that and I finally get why people love this class.
Worth learning properly, I would sign up for the full class.

steps.title: The class
steps.position: At the class schedule
steps.direction: Film the schedule and move in slowly to the coach's class and its time.

captions.script: This move is from their class, here is when it runs.
Book the full class on Loca, times are on the board.

templates.title: Treatment booking
templates.summary: A massage, facial or IV bar visit: the empty room, the menu with prices, the walkthrough and how it felt.

steps.title: The room
steps.position: At the treatment room door, before the session
steps.direction: Start with the lens behind the door frame or curtain, then step past it so the empty room appears.

captions.script: This is the room for my first treatment here, and it is spotless.
Booked a session, and this is where it happens.

steps.title: The menu
steps.position: At the reception, by the treatment menu
steps.direction: Hold the phone straight above the menu and point to the treatment you booked and its price.

captions.script: Here is what I booked and what it costs.
The full menu with prices, and here is the one I picked.

steps.title: The walkthrough
steps.position: Facing the practitioner, before the session
steps.direction: Back camera on the practitioner as they explain, front camera on you. Say what they told you.
steps.prompter: They walked me through the whole session before we even started.

captions.script: They walked me through the whole session before we even started.
They told me exactly what happens before we started.

steps.title: During
steps.position: On the table, phone propped on a shelf above
steps.direction: Prop the phone looking straight down at your hands or feet on the towel. Film only yourself.

captions.script: Phone down, eyes closed, and this time is mine.
Quiet time, and nobody asking me anything.

steps.title: How it felt
steps.position: In the lounge or at the door, after
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length. Say how you felt walking out, nothing more.
steps.prompter: Walked out slow and quiet, I did not want to talk to anyone.

captions.script: Walked out slow and quiet, I did not want to talk to anyone.
After the session I feel calm, and I am booking the next one.

steps.title: Find it
steps.position: At the entrance, by the name plate
steps.direction: Start close on the name plate or sign, then lean back slowly so the entrance appears.

captions.script: Book this treatment through Loca, the price is on screen.
This is the entrance, so look for the sign.

templates.title: First appointment
templates.summary: A first visit to a clinic: the door, the empty waiting room, the person who treats you and the first-visit price.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.position: Outside, a few steps from the clinic door
steps.direction: Phone at chest height, walk slowly up to the door until it fills the screen.

captions.script: My first appointment here, and I will be honest, I was nervous.
Trying a new clinic, and this is the door.

steps.title: Waiting room
steps.position: Inside, by the waiting area, when it is empty
steps.direction: Only when nobody is waiting: start behind a plant or the door frame, then step past it to show the room.

captions.script: Here is the waiting room, and how long I waited.
This is the waiting room, clean and calm.

steps.title: Meet them
steps.position: Next to the clinician, before the appointment
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, a little above eye level with the clinician beside you, both in frame. Keep screens and files out of shot.
steps.prompter: Meeting the person doing my first appointment, I came with a lot of questions.

captions.script: Meeting the person doing my first appointment, I came with a lot of questions.
This is who will see me today, and I have my questions ready.

steps.title: The room
steps.position: In the treatment room, before you sit down
steps.direction: Back camera on the clinician pointing to the chair or one piece of kit, front camera on you. Move in slowly.
steps.prompter: They showed me each tool before using it, which helped a lot.

captions.script: They showed me each tool before using it, which helped a lot.
Everything was explained first, which matters when you are nervous.

steps.title: First visit price
steps.position: At the reception, by the price list
steps.direction: Hold the phone straight above the first-visit price on the list or leaflet. Keep the screen and any names out.

captions.script: Here is what a first visit costs, and what it includes.
The first appointment price, right here on the list.

steps.title: Verdict
steps.position: Outside the clinic, after
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length with the entrance behind you. Say how the visit went.
steps.prompter: Clean, calm and nobody rushed me, I would book the next one here.

captions.script: Clean, calm and nobody rushed me, I would book the next one here.
Would I go back? Yes, and I would book it on Loca.

door.reads: The door grows until it fills the frame; the next shot opens inside on the price board.

desk.reads: The prices fill the frame, then the desk and the studio sign appear around them; cut to the selfie with the coach.

coach.reads: Two faces at arm's length, held still; the camera flips to the back lens for the class.

reps.reads: From the floor, the creator moves through a rep; match-cut on the top of the rep to the hands.

grip.reads: Hands fill the frame from above and work through one rep; cut to the front camera after class.

after.reads: Face at arm's length, still, while the verdict lands; cut to the schedule board.

book.reads: The schedule grows until the class name fills the frame; hold still for the outro.

kit.reads: The kit grows above the lens until it fills the frame; whip right onto the training floor.

floor.reads: The room turns past from left to right after the whip settles; cut close to the racks.

racks.reads: Handles slide past the lens, front ones faster than the back; cut to walking into the changing room.

changing.reads: The door frame slides off and the empty changing room appears; cut to the owner at the desk.

owner.reads: The owner at the desk, held still in the back camera while the creator speaks; cut to the front camera outside.

outside.reads: Face and sign at arm's length, held still for the outro.

door.reads: The door opens and the wood grows until it fills the frame; the next shot opens on the benches.

room.reads: From the bench boards the room opens around them until the stove and door are in frame; cut to the bag on the bench.

bag.reads: Hands place each item into the frame from above; cut to the floor-level shot of the walk in.

step-in.reads: From the floor, the creator walks through the door and it closes; cut to the front camera in the rest area.

after.reads: Face at arm's length, held still for the line; cut to the session prices at the desk.

price.reads: The price list grows until the session line fills the frame; hold for the outro.

demo.reads: The coach moves through one rep from below; match-cut on the coach to eye level.

coach.reads: The coach holds still in the back camera while the creator speaks; cut to straight above the feet.

stance.reads: Feet or hands settle into position from above; cut to the wide floor shot of the creator.

copy.reads: The creator repeats the move in a wide frame from the floor; cut to the front camera.

verdict.reads: Face at arm's length, still; cut to the schedule on the wall.

class.reads: The schedule grows until the class time fills the frame; hold for the outro.

room.reads: The door frame slides away and the dressed table appears; cut to the menu from straight above.

menu.reads: A finger lands on one line of the menu from above; cut to the practitioner at eye level.

walkthrough.reads: The practitioner talks in the back camera, held still; cut to above the creator's hands.

during.reads: Hands rest still on the towel from above; match-cut on the creator to the front camera after.

after.reads: Face at arm's length, still; cut to the name plate at the entrance.

sign.reads: The name plate shrinks as the entrance appears around it; hold for the outro.

door.reads: The door grows until it fills the frame; the next shot opens on the waiting room behind a pillar or plant.

waiting.reads: The blocker slides away and the empty waiting room opens up; cut to the selfie with the clinician.

meet.reads: Two faces at arm's length, held still; the camera flips to the back lens on the room.

tools.reads: The kit grows in the back camera while the creator speaks; cut to the price list from above.

price.reads: The price line held still from above; cut to the front camera outside.

verdict.reads: Face and entrance at arm's length, held still for the outro.
